judgingGuide.title: Judging guide
judgingGuide.lead: Your school judges the first round. Use this guide, the same for every school, so the round is fair and quick.

framework.title: FOA's judging framework
items: Appoint a small judging panel from your school.
Judge each entry against the rubric of its discipline below. Give each criterion a score within its range; each criterion counts for its share of the total.
Name 1st, 2nd and 3rd for each category, and pick your shortlist for the next level.
Your coordinator confirms that the competition and its judging followed FOA's guidelines.
